newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 10.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 45.32 points at 6,563.84 as blue-chip stocks fell on profit-taking.

* The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading of minor-sized Bank Pikko late on Tuesday following a 207.69 percent rise in the stock. An exchange official said on Thursday the stock was expected to resume trading in the afternoon session depending on the final results of the exchange's investigation.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 1.58 points, or 0.25 percent, to close at 638.22 points. The market was closed on Wednesday for a public holiday
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,406.40/06.75 at 0200 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,405.50/06.25.
* Bank Pikko as it was expected to resume trading in the afternoon session on Thursday.
* Sampoerna after reports it had raised the retail (banderol) price of its leading Dji Sam Soe brand.
* Banks PDFCI and Bank Panin after announcements on Thursday of rises in their 1996 net profits.
* Second-liner property firm Bhuwanatala on reports business tycoon Johannes Kotjo had bought a 36 percent stake in a large Surabaya property firm Darmo Satelite through Bhuwanatala.
